verdict.rationale: Apple's own docs say Siri AI can take actions in apps such as Messages, Music and Reminders based on context, hold natural back-and-forth conversations, act on what is on screen, and draft text from plain-language descriptions. Spotlight also lets users search and take action without opening apps, so the core of natural-language operation is documented. Missing for 10: evidence of natural-language control over the OS as a whole (system settings, file and window management) beyond a named set of apps, and any independent or hands-on corroboration of how well these first-party claims work.
